gates.scope: Bounded representative runtime parallelism, not universal workload saturation.

summary.outside_timed_scope: Interpreter startup, inputs, preparation/planning, compilation, mandatory call, configured warmups, validation and teardown; individual compile/setup durations unavailable from unchanged adapters.

monitoring.caveat: CPU/wall and busy fractions include startup/preparation/compilation/warmups; not timed-kernel occupancy. Process samples may miss terminal cleanup CPU time.

limitations: Frequency unlocked; exclusive Slurm allocation does not remove OS activity or thermal/cache/history effects.
Rounds are sequential across three allocations on the same node, not randomized or statistically significant scaling trials.
Process wall/CPU measurements include startup/setup/compilation/warmup and are not timed-kernel utilization.
Input/allocator/GC policies are the actual backends' policies, not identical allocator microbenchmarks.

Pinned upstream network comparisons use one compilation call then100 outer samples (inner1); this uses two extra warmups and a common7–100 repeat plan across three paired rounds. This is not the separate upstream BenchmarkTools suite.

derived_from_existing_samples.method: Public aggregator _statistics: math.fsum(samples_ms) / len(samples_ms); pooled over all recorded timings, without filtering, truncation or subtraction.
